messages:
sam: RFC draft posted — routing guardrails for latency-led routing + quantized kernel defaults + KV prefetch behavior. Need product acceptance criteria and a quick prioritization for customer-driven asks.

michelle: skimmed. TL;DR looks reasonable. Major ask from Customer-Z is <100ms p50 for short chats (<=64 tokens) without >2x cost.

raj: can we define 'short chat' precisely in the PRD? suggest <=64 tokens OR <150ms generation window. also need a rollback metric if quality drops (BLEU/ROUGE not great; use customer prompt set).

elaine: acceptance criteria proposal: 1) p50 <=100ms for short chat on dedicated tier; 2) cost per 1k tokens <= baseline*1.8; 3) no significant quality regression on customer prompt set (measured via evaluation harness with <3% degradation on key intents).

sam: +1 to elaine. also add ops requirement: automatic fallback to FP kernel when eval shows regression for more than 5% of prompts in a 1h window.

david: implementation note — quant kernel gives ~2.3x throughput on our bench but worse on some LLMs with long KV. Need a preflight run per-model to compute break-even seq length for cost/latency.

raj: that argues for model-specific routing rules in the runtime catalog. PRD should include a config surface: {model_id, seq_break_even, default_kernel, fallback_policy, prefetch_enabled}.

michelle: product asks: make these configs editable in console (canary controls, rollout %), and expose token-level cost estimate for each kernel in UI. customers want to preview cost impact before flipping defaults.

sam: good. also performance edge cases: 1) bursts where batching could increase p50 — must honor latency SLOs by routing to isolated low-batch pool for short-chat traffic. 2) KV prefetch eviction: keep MRU for prefix keys for at least 5 minutes for active sessions.

elaine: acceptance criteria for edge cases: - under 95th percentile burst load (based on QPS window), short-chat p50 still <=150ms; - KV prefetch TTL and eviction policy documented and configurable per-customer; - observable metrics: per-route kernel selection, fallback counts, quality regression alerts.

david: ops checklist for launch: preflight per-model benchmarks uploaded, canary traffic for 48h at 1-5% then 25% then full; automated rollback if fallback rate >2% or quality regression >3% on canary prompts.

raj: tiny UX ask — in console show why a request routed to FP kernel (reason codes: QUALITY_FAIL, CAPACITY_FALLBACK, EXPLICIT_PIN).

sam: noted. can someone draft a short PRD section with acceptance criteria + rollout plan? I'll paste RFC link into product board.

michelle: I'll take PRD section for product + console bits. raj will draft runtime config schema. david + ops will add benches + rollout playbook. elaine will enumerate customer prompt sets for eval.

deploy-bot: canary job scheduled: runtime-canary/quant-routing v1 -> starts in 24h. :rocket:

sam: great — aim to have PRD + config schema by EOD Fri. if blockers surface, flag here. :thumbsup:
